question: Was Adult's identity gain caused by supervised field selection, a separate identity channel, or both?
selection_note: The supervised columns are the frozen Day 1 cross-fitted residual diagnostic; the target-free set is exactly the nonconstant numeric fields with train cardinality <=128.
capacity_control: compressed Q-PLE-bin codes use exactly the same tables, gates, interface, and parameters as exact support
primary_gate: exact support must beat its bin control and plain Q-PLE in validation log loss; a mechanism is architecture-bearing if this holds in at least 2/3 architectures
tple_gate: the winning supervised interface must also beat plain T-PLE in validation log loss in at least 2/3 architectures
